What A.Team sells

  • Agentic Teammates: Teams build business AI agents that the client owns.
  • Intelligence Layer: Shared context and accumulated learning that the AI teammates read and update.
  • Forward Deployed Engineers: Senior engineers embed with customers to integrate, deploy and harden AI software.
  • Technical Talent: Technical specialists join hourly or ongoing work, including advisory engagements.
